༄༅/ /sman bla'i rnam gzhag cho ga nyams len bde 'jug bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /sman bla'i rnam gzhag cho ga nyams len bde 'jug bzhugs so/ /

na mo mañdzu shṝ ye/ bla ma rnams dang skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum/ bde gshegs bdun dang thub dbang 'jam dbyangs la/ /btud nas bde gshegs bdun gyi mdo sde yi/ /cho ga'i rnam gzhag tshul bzhin bshad par bya/ 'di la bzhi ste mdo las gsungs tshul/ zhi 'tshos bsdus tshul/ bod du dar tshul/ nyams su blang tshul lo/ /dang po la ston pa ni shākya'i rgyal po'o/ /dus ni bka' dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor gyi dus ni nam yang ma yin ste/ 'di'i ming gi zhu ba po sogs ni kun dga' bo yin la de ni ston pa sangs rgyas pa'i lor 'khrungs nas lo bdun gyi bar du ston pa dang zhal yang ma mjal ba'i phyir ro/ /der ma zad 'khor lo bar pa las kyang phyi ste/ spyod phyogs rgya chen po gtso bor ston pa shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod yin pas 'khor lo tha mar gtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnas ni/ yangs pa can gyi rol mo'i sgra gcan gyi shing ljon pa'i tshal lo/ /'khor ni dge slong brgyad khri dang byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dang blo gros chen po dang byams pa dang spobs pa rtsegs nas lag na rdo rje bar mtshan smros pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa sum khri drug stong dang*/ gzhan yang theg pa chen po la lhag par mos pa'i lha klu la sogs pa grangs med pa'o/ zhu ba po ni chos kyi rgyal bu gzhon nur gyur pa 'jam dpal lo/ /ched du bya ba'i gdul bya ni/ lnga brgya tha ma la dam pa'i chos ltar bcos pa 'byung ba na nad sna tshogs kyis gzir ba la sogs pa'i sems can no/ /chos ni/ gang thos pa tsam gyis bla na med pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur pa dang bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'gyur ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa'am/ lag na rdo rjes dam bcas pa'am las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong zhing re ba thams cad yongs su bskong ba'am/

gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon bcu gnyis kyis dam bcas pa'i mdo sde sde tshan gyi rnam grangs bzhi dang ldan pa'i shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod do/ /gsung tshul dngos ni 'jam dbyangs kyis zhus ston pas legs so gnang nas gsungs te 'di la'ang bdun ka'i zhing bkod smon lam so sor gsungs pa dang*/ sman bla'i mtshan gyi phan yon bye brag du gsungs pa'o/ /'di la gdan ma mdzom bar gyi bka' mchid dang*/ gdan mdzoms nas kyi bka' mchid do/ /dang po la mtshan gyi phan yon ston pas gsungs/ skyabs grol gyis bshad| gnod sbyin la mngon du gyur pa'o/ /dang po la ston pas rgya cher gsungs/ 'jam dpal gyis mtshan bsgrags par dam bcas shing mdo sde gnas par bsrung ma sbran/ ston pas kun dga' bo la yid ches bskyed pa'o/ /dang po la ser sna dang*/ tshul 'chal dang nga rgyal dang phrag dog dang phra ma dang las sbyor ngan pa byas pas rnam smin cher myong ba rnams kyang sngon sman bla'i mtshan thos pa dran nas sdug bsngal las thar te bde ba phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba dang*/ bslab pa thams cad 'chal kyang rnam smin mi 'byung zhing 'khor los sgyur rgyal sogs su skye ba dang bud med kyi skye gnas las thar zhing bu nor tshe dang dbang phyug gang 'dod 'byung la bu btsa' ba'i tshe nad mi 'byung ba sogs gsungs pa'o/ /gnyis pa la nad drag po dang shi ba gsos shing rgyal srid la nyer 'tshe mi 'byung zhing zhi bar bshad/ kun dga' bos srog dbang chad pa slar mtshams mi sbyor ba'i rtsod pa 'god/ skyabs grol gyis dus min gyi 'chi ba bcu gso bar theg chen gyi lung las gsungs pas rtsod pa spang ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ mtshan thos pas gnod sbyin bdun 'bum phrag bcu gnyis kyis bden pa mthong nas mdo 'di bsrung bar dam bcas pa'o/ /gnyis pa la lha'i bu kha cig don de dag la yid gnyis skyes/ ston pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing bskul ba zhes bya ba'i ting 'dzin mngon du mdzad nas bde gshegs bdun spyan drangs/

gdan mdzoms pa la 'jam dbyangs kyis baiḍūr+ya'i gzungs zhus brgyad kas mgrin gcig tu phan yon rgyas pa dang bcas pa gsungs| gsang bdag 'khor bcas kyis bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi khyad par rgyas pa yang thos/ zhes pa nas 'bel ba'i bka' 'chid kyang bgyid/ re ba thams cad yongs su bkang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes pa'i bar smras/ gdan mdzoms pas phyag rdor gyi gzungs byin gyis brlabs shing tshangs pa sogs la bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgos| kun dga' bos chos kyi rnam grangs kyi ming zhus pa rnams kyis mdo'i don yongs su rdzogs so/ /zhi 'tshos bsdus tshul la/ sngon 'gro bshams shing bsgom pa/ dngos gzhi phyag mchod smon lam/ mjug tu bzod gsol gshegs gsol lo/ /dang po la bsham pa dang sgom pa'o/ /dang po la 'gal rkyen bsal ba dang mthun rkyen bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po la phyi khrus ni/ lus legs par dkrus zhing gos gtsang ma bgo ba'o/ /nang khrus ni zas gtsang ma za zhing sems nyon mongs pa dang bral ba'o/ /mthun rkyen la/ bsam pa khyad par can/ yar dad gus mar tshad med bar du sdom pa bzung ba'o/ /dus khyad par can tshes brgyad sogs dang*/ gnas khyad par can yid du 'ong ba phyag dar dang chag chag la sogs pas gtsang mar byas te/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan mang pos brgyan pa/ rten khyad par can spos kyi maṇ+ḍal chen po bya ste zhes pa dri bzang gi dkyil 'khor bya ba ste/ 'og na 'byung ba ltar gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu ste/ 'dod snam cha phran gnyis pa dang*/ gzhan gnyis re re ba byas pas sgo khyud kyang sgo tshad re re'o/ /de'i nang du lha snam nyis rim/ dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad seng ge'i khri dang bcas pa bris la/ tshon phye'am me tog gis bgram zhes pa tsam las ma gsungs pas tshon sna lngas mdzes tshon byas la/ yang na 'os med kyi rigs pas pad+ma 'dab brgyad la shar du sman thub gnyis/

lhor mtshan zla gnyis sogs bskor bas/ shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang khu'am dmar skya ste/ sman bla ni baiḍūr+ya'i 'od ces gsungs kyang gzhan rnams kyi sku mdog nges pa dka' bas mdzes tshon du gsal lo/ /lte bar chos po ti dang*/ snam bu :dar ma [ dharma ] la/ gleng gzhi'i byang sems bcu gnyis kyi steng du 'jam dpal dang skyabs grol nyi ma dang zla ba ltar snang byed bcu drug phyi ma'i g.yon gral la gnod sbyin bcu gnyis/ g.yas gral la tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyis mtshon pa'i phyogs skyong bcu sgo bzhir rgyal chen bzhi'i lha mtshan bya zhing bde gshegs brgyad ni lugs sku'am ras bris sam 'jim pas byas pa'ang rung ste ring srel dang bcas pa bya bar gsungs pas dkyil 'khor gyi gdan so sor dgod cing bris sku yina'ang tsa ka li'i tshul du dgod par bya'o/ /mchod pa khyad par can sku gzugs re re la mar me dang tshon sna lnga pa'i ba dan bdun bdun ni lan mang du mdo las gsungs pas nges par dgos la/ gzhan yang spos dang me tog sogs dang rin chen sna bdun dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad sogs kyis mtha' 'khor ba legs par bshams/ bum pa la sogs pa sta gon bya bar gsungs shing*/ mjug du khrus gsol bar bshad pas bum pa dri bzang gi chus bkang ba ras bzang po'i mgul chings dang shing bzang po'i kha rgyan dang bcas pa bsham mo// rgyab chog khyad par can mdo sde 'di dang sher phyin la sogs pa'i mdo sde mang po klog mkhan bzhag cing*/ dge slong gi dge 'dun 'dzom gang che la bsnyen bskur bya'o/ /grangs tshad khyad par can cho ga 'di zhag bdun yan chad zhag zhe dgu man chad bar ma chad par bya ba'i yo byad bshams pa'o/ /sgom pa ni/ bdag med kyi lta ba'i ting 'dzin ci nus su bsgoms pa las langs nas/ des ma rig pa'i sems can la tshad med bzhi dang byang chub kyi sems bsgoms nas/ sa gzhi| khang bzang*/ gdan khri/

mchod pa byin brlabs te byin brlabs bzhi bskor grangs tshang ba lan gsum/ spyan 'drain lus sbrid pa sogs ky-i mtshan ma 'byung nges byas nas gnas su dgod pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa la/ mdor bstan spyi phyag gi rgyas bshad so so'i mjug bsdus gtang rag phyag mchod smon lam mo/ /mjug chog gzhung na gsal ste de dag la rgyas bshad so so'i phyag mchod smon lam ni gong du mdo nas gsungs tshul bshad pa dang sgrigs pas gsal la/ gzhan thams cad mdo 'dir khrigs chags su mi gsal yang slob dpon bdag nyid chen po 'dis mdo gzhan nas 'byung ba dang 'grig bya ba spyi'i cho ga nas cung zad blang du rung ba rnams bsdus par gsal lo/ khyad par ston pas kun dga' bo la yid ches bskyed pa'i don ni chos dkon mchog smon lam de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' yang dag pa zhes sogs yin zhing cho ga'i gzhung dag pa rnams su yang de ltar 'byung yang 'chims nam mkha' grags kyis gsal por ma 'byor bas 'khrul gzhi byas nas shāka thub la sbyor ba shin tu mang ba ni zhi 'tshos chos la bstod phyag mdzad nas smon lam gyi skal ba gcad par thal bas gnod pa dang*/ mdo dang cho ga sbyor tshul khong du ma chud pa'i skyon no/ gsum pa bod du dar tshul ni/ spyir bod du mi chags pa ni rgyal po sgra ngan dang skya seng 'thab pa'i tshe sgra ngan pham nas dpung tshogs du ma bud med kyi chas su zhugs shing bud med dang bcas te byang phyogs kyi ri brag du bros pa las mched par lha las phul byung gi 'grel par bshad pas shin tu snga mo yin la rgyal po thog ma ni ston pa dang dgung zla mnyam pa'i rgyal po shar pa'i bu tha chung sor mo dra bas 'brel ba dang mig yas 'gebs pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ltas khyad par can byung ba mtshan mkhan gyis dpyod ma shes par ga ṅgā la ga'ur bcug ste skyur ba zhing pas gsos te/ phyis rgyu mtshan bshad pas skyo ba skyes te byang phyogs kyi nags khrod du 'khyams pa las kyi rdzul 'phrul gyis yar lung su phebs pa phyug rdzis gnya' bar khri bcas te spyan drangs pas gnya' khri gtsan po yin la de nas rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa lngar lha 'dre rang gis bslabs pa'i snang bshen pas lha mchod byas nas nad pa'i rim gro sogs byas pas chab srid bon gyis bskyangs par grags so//

de nas kun bzang gi rnam 'phrul lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi ring la mdo sde za ma tog dang dpang skong phyag rgya pa dang*/ gtsug gtor dri med dang gser gyi mchod sdong rnams pho brang gi yang thog du phebs pa ngo ma shes kyang gnyan po gsang bar btags nas mchod pas dge legs byung ste chos kyi dbu brnyes so// de nas rgya rabs lnga na lha sa'i chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos sgrol ma dang khro gnyer can gyi sprul pa'i btsun mo gnyis rgya bal nas bsu ba de gnyis kyis jo bo shākya gnyis la sogs pa spyan drangs shing*/ ra sa dang ra mo che'i gtsug [ lag ] khang dang 'phags pa rang byung lnga ldan sogs bzhengs pas sangs rgyas kyi rten tshugs shing chos kyi rten yang pan+ṭi ta shākya sing ha sogs gcig gnyis spyan drangs lo tsā ba thon mi samabho ṭas yi ge brtsams te dpang skong phyag rgya pa sogs bsgyur bas tshugs mod/ dge 'dun ni med de/ dge ba bcu'i khrims tsam la brten no/ /de nas rgya rabs lnga na bsam yas kyi chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis dkon mchog gsum ka'i rten rgya cher tshugs te dar zhing rgyas par mdzad la/ khyad par shar phyogs za hor gyi mkhas sgrub chen po mtshan zhi ba 'tshos/ sad mi mi bdun la sogs pa gces phrug shes rab can gsum brgya'i rab byung bsnyen rdzogs kyi mkhan po mdzad pas/ mkhan chen byang chub kyi thugs lhag par 'byongs pas bo dhi satwa'o/ /bdag nyid chen po 'dis chos rgyal gyi sku rim du cho ga 'di dang gtsug tor dri med kyi gzungs chog mdzad nas rgyal po nyid la gnang*/ thugs dam du mdzad pas phun tshogs thams cad 'phel lo/ des snar thang pa'i bzhed pa ltar na sras phyi ma khri lde'am sad na legs dang*/ des mnga' dag khri ral/ des lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ des 'od bsrungs| des dpal 'khor btsan/ des mnga' ris stod du 'byon dgos byung ba nyi ma mgon/

des bkra shis lde/ des 'khor re/ 'od bsrungs nas 'di'i bar ni yab sras so/ /'dis rang gi gcung po srong nge/ des khong rang gi sras lha lde| de la sras gsum ste 'od lde byang chub 'od zhi ba 'od do/ /'od lde'i sras rtse lde| de nas mnga' ris gnar las brgyud par bzhed do/ /bu ston ltar na khri srong lde btsan gyi sras che ba mu ne btsan po des rang gi gcung po sad na legs/ des rang gi sras gtsang ma/ des dar ma'i sras 'od bsrung*| des rang gi sras dpal 'khor btsan/ de nas 'khor ra'i bar snga ma bzhin| 'khor re rab tu byung ba'i mtshan ye shes 'od/ des rang gi dbon po byang chub 'od/ des rang gi mched zla pho brang zhi ba 'od/ des kyang rang gi gcen 'od kyi lde/ des rang gi sras mnga' bdag rtse lde ste/ de rnams chos rgyal rkyang pa'i rim pa yin la/ de yang 'od bsrung yan chad snga dar dang*/ man chad phyi dar ro| |de nas mnga' ris pa gnar byang chub tshul khrims zhes pas/ spa bskor brag nag tu bzhugs pas dge bshes brag nag pa zhes grags so/ /des gtsang gi lhan dung lhar byon/ rus pa zhu yin pa zhu lhan pa shes rab grags pa/ 'dis sman bla mdzad pas bde gshegs 'khor bcas mngon sum du spyan 'drongs pa pho rog pa mdo sde mgon gyis brag sngon phug pa nas gzigs par grags/ zhu lhan pas| ra sa chu lhad pa dar ma rgyal mtshan la gnang*/ des snar thang pa gro mo cher mtshan thogs pa mtshan dngos gros ston bdud rtsi grags la/ des mchog zung ngam sras gnyis su grags pa/ sangs rgyas sgom pa dang seng ge rgyal mtshan/ de gsum la 'chims nam mkha' grags/ de nas bshes gnyen chen po bsod nams ye shes/ byang sems bsod nams grags/ chos rje bsod rgyal/ thogs med bzang po dpal/ lo chen skyabs mchog dpal bzang*/ mkhan po rin po che don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te seng ge rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bar du rim gyis brgyud cing de'i drung du bdag gis cho ga'i lung thob/

yang brag nag pa rin po che seng ge bzang po'i drung du sprul sku'i rjes gnang thob cing longs sku'i rjes gnang du grags pa rig pa'i dbang lnga tsam la rigs lnga'i sdom bzung byed pa'i phyag srol cig 'dug pa ni ma dag par nges nas bdag gis ma zhus so// de ltar na cho ga khyad par can 'di ni/ mkhan chen gyis bod yul du mdzad cing rgya gar na dar bar ma grags pas/ spyir snyigs :pa [ ma ] lda bdo'i bod gangs can pa dang khyad par chos rgyal byang chub sems pa'i gdung dang srol 'dzin pa rnams kyis thugs nyams su bzhed par rigs la/ yang dgos jo bo yab sras nas brgyud pa'i bka' gdams pa rnams la/ bde gshegs brgyad dang gnas brtan bcu drug gi mchod pa'i cho ga 'di 'brel shin tu che bar jo bo yab sras kyi rnam thar thun mong pa kun dang thun mong ma yin pa bka' gdams glegs bam du rgyas par gsungs pas de dag gis shin tu 'bad par rigs so/ /bzhi pa nyams su len tshul la/ phan yon gyi spro ba bskyed/ rnam gzhag gi nges pa bskyed/ lag len gyi phan yon sgrub pa'o/ /dang po la dad par dang ba'i dang*/ dad nas mchod pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ rgyud las/ dad pa sangs rgyas dad pa chos/ /dad pa dge 'dun dad pa pha/ /dad pa ma ste dad pa grogs/ /zhes sogs dang mdo las/ dad pa sngon 'gro ma ltar bskyed pa ste/ /zhes sogs dang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis| 'di gnyis gtso bo shes rab ste/ /'di yi sngon 'gro dad pa yin/ zhes dang*| chos mngon pa las kyang*/ sems byung dge ba bcu gcig gi thog mar dad pa gsungs nas/ dad pa sngon du ma btang zhing*/ grogs su med pa'i sbyin sogs thams cad dge bar mi 'gyur zhing*/ mdo las/ dad pa med pa'i mi rnams la/ /dkar po'i chos rnams mi 'khrungs te/ /zhes dad pa med na dge ba mi srid par gsungs pas/ dad pa ni dkar chos thams cad kyi thog mtha' bar gsum med du mi rung ba yin pas na/

dge ba byed pa kun dang khyad par las dang po pas 'di nyid 'bad par bya zhing*/ de yang dkon mchog gi yon tan la dang ba'i dang*/ las 'bras la yid ches pa'i dang*/ bden bzhi'i blang dor la byed 'dod pa'i dad pa gsum las kyang dang po nyid thog mar bskyed par bya bas| dkon mchog spyi dgos kyi yon tan ston pa'i gsung rab la blta ba sogs kyi sgo nas rang rgyud kyi rnyog pa zhi ba'i dang ba'i dad pa skye ba la 'bad par bya'o// gnyis pa la dkon mchog spyi dang khyad par bde gshegs bdun dang yang dgos sman bla mchod pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ sa'i snying po 'khor lo bcu pa'i mdo las/ khams gsum dag na bde zhing skyid pa thams cad dkon mchog mchod las byung bas/ des na bde zhing skyid pa 'dod pas dkon mchog gsum po mchod la brtson par bya// zhes sogs 'phral gyi bde skyid dang phugs kyi phan pa thams cad dkon mchog mchod pa las byung bar gsungs shing*/ 'jig rten phal pa'ang lha ma mchod pas lo ma legs zhes sogs myong bas grub nas 'jig rten pa lha 'dre gsol mchod la brtson par byed na/ bslu med gtan gyi skyabs gnas yon tan yongs su rdzogs pas legs pa kun gyi 'byung gnas dkon mchog gsum la lta ci smos pa'i phyir dang*/ phyin drug gi thog ma ni sbyin pa dang*/ sbyin pa'i gtso bo ni/ mchod bslab yang dag blang ba dang*/ /zhes dkon mchog mchod pa nyid yin par gsungs pa sogs mang ngo*/ /gnyis pa ni/ spyir sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i bsod nams gzhal du med par gsung ste/ rang rgyal dgra bcom bye ba brgya phrag la lo mang du bsnyen bkur byas pa bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la dang ba'i sems kyis yud tsam zhig mig gis bltas pa bsod nams che bar gsungs pa sogs kyi phyir dang*/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la bram ze zhig gi lam kha cig tu bstod pa tshig gcig byas pas bskal pa chen po nyi shu'i bar du ngan song gi sgo khegs pa sogs gsungs la/

de yang sangs rgyas bzhugs dus mngon sum mchod bstod dang bsnyen bskur byas pa bas kyang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su ring srel dang gsung rab dang de 'dzin pa'i chos smra la byas pa phan yon che zhing*/ khyad par dam pa'i chos 'jig du nye ba na mchod pa phul na bsod nams che ba dang*| mchod pa yang rnyed pa ni mchod pa lha bshos dang na bza' 'bul ba sogs la gsungs kyang*/ bkur sti'i mchod pa phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ bstod pa'i 'don pa sogs lhag cing*/ de bas kyang rim gro'i mchod pa rten gsum gsar du bzhengs pa dang*/ rnying pa gso ba sogs lhag de bas kyang*/ sgrub pa'i mchod pa thos bsam sgo gsum dang*/ mdo sngags kyi cho ga dang*/ dad pas kun nas blang ba lhag par gsungs so/ khyad par bde gshegs bdun dang*/ yang dgos sman bla'i mtshan lan bdun brjod cing yid kyi dran pa dang re re'i spyan sngar mar me bdun bdun sogs kyis phyag mchod byas pa'i phan yon/ bsdus pa rnams cho ga nyid du gsal zhing rgyas pa rnams mdo sde na zhugs pas gong gi mdo nas gsungs tshul la lde mig byas te 'di'i dgos kyi mdo sde la 'dris par bya'o//gsum pa ni/ mdo 'di'i phyed smad kyi phan yon thams cad sman gyi rgyal po'i thabs mkhas dang smon lam dang mtshan gyi phan yon kho na yin pas na/ bde gshegs bdun nam brgyad la gsol ba 'debs snyam la mtshan legs kyi cho ga shāka thub kyi cho ga zhes sogs mi brjod par sman bla'i cho ga zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan shes par byas nas bde gshegs 'di nyid la gtso bor bya ste/ mchims pas bde gshegs gzhan drug la phyag bdun bdun/ shāka thub sogs la bco lnga| sman bla la nyer gcig bya bar bshad do/ /mtshan gyi phan yon rgya cher gsungs pa'i don bsdus pa ni/ jo bo rjes :mthon mthing

[ mtho lding ] gser gyi lha khang du zhing khams gtso bo re la bstod pa gsar pa re mdzad pa'i tshe/ bde gshegs brgyad la mtshan gyi me tog sogs mdzad pa'i nang na sman bla la/ mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i gdung ba sel/ /zhes par 'dus pas spyir sdig can dang dgos bslab pa nyams pa sogs ngan song gi 'jig pa nye bar gnas pa rnams kyi nan tan du bya'o/ /spyir bstan pa nyams dma' ru song nas gsung rab spyi dang gzungs sngags sogs kyi mthu chung du 'gro bar gsungs mod mdo 'di ni dus ngan snyigs ma'i sems can gyi don du nan gyis gsungs pas nus pa che ru 'gro bar shes nas 'bad par bya'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ kun rig gi lag len cung zad shes pa dag gis 'dir yang oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ la sogs pa'i lag len mang du sbyar ba ni mi 'thad pa chen po yin te/ /spyir mdo sngags 'og ma 'og ma'i thun mong ba rnams gong ma gong mar rjes su 'gro zhing blang du rung yang gong ma'i dgos chos rnams 'og mar blang du gtan mi rung zhing*/ 'og ma'i thun mong min pa yang gong mar mi 'gro ba'i phyir dang*/ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ zhes sogs phyag rgya dang bcas nas brjod pa la rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi lha'i nga rgyal brtan po dgos pa las rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi mtshan yang ma tshor ba mang pos byar mi rung ba ma zad/ gang zhig phyag rgya mi mkhas la// lus kyi phyag rgya ston pa sogs kyi nyes pa 'byung ba'i phyir dang 'di ni 'byung khungs dang lag len rgyas par mdzad pa po mchims thams cad mkhyen pas yo ga dang sbyar ba gtan ma mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /des kyang gzhal yas khang gi thig tshon gyi skabs su drwa phyed shar bu rnga yab rta babs pad rdor sogs mdzad cing*/ pho brang du grags pa mang po'i dar sham gyi tsa ka li la dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgo dang sgo 'khyud drwa phyed sogs byas pa'ang mi 'thad de/ mdo'i khungs med la/

rgyud kyi khungs rnams skabs ma 'brel ba'i phyir ro/ kha cig mdo 'di bya rgyud du bsdus nas rgyud kyi cho gar byed pa'ang mi rigs te/ mdo'i cho ga gtan med du thal ba dang yod na mtshan gzhi btsal bas mi rnyed cing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi cho ga mdo sde las bsdus pa zhes dang*/ mdo sde las byung ba'i cho ga bzhin du zhes dang*/ mdo sde'i cho ga yongs su rdzogs par bkang zhes sogs dang*/ dngos su 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /cis ste dpal de kho na nyid 'dus pa zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo zhes yo ga'i rtsa rgyud las bshad pa gsang 'dus kyi sgrub thabs mdo dang bsres zhes pa rgyud kyi lung dang sbyar ba'i ming du bshad pa sogs kyis ma nges so zhes na/ sū tra'i skad dod mdo zhes pa tsam gyis ni mdo rgyud gang du'ang 'byed mi nus te sgra mdo bzhin no/ /mdo sde dang rgyud sde zhes pa sū tra se na lta bus ni mdo sngags gnyis su phye ba'i mdo sder 'byed nus pa'i skyon med cing*/ gzhan du na mdo sngags mi 'gal bar 'gyur la/ de ltar 'dod na de gnyis tha dad du 'byed pa'i mtshan nyid dam khyad par mi 'dra ba mang du mdzad pa dang 'gal lo/ kha cig mdo sngags kyi khyad par gzungs sngags yod med yin pa mdo 'di la gzungs sngags mang du yod pas rgyud yin no zer ba ni/ 'dul ba lung gis ma nges so/ sgrub bya'i mdo ni rgyud yin la sgrub byed kyi cho ga mdo lugs yin no zer ba ni/ bya rgyud kyi lha la bla med dang*/ yo ga'i sgrub tshul rung kyang bla med nas gsungs pa'i lha zhal sbyor la bya rgyud kyi bsgrub thabs mi rung ba dang 'dra bas mi 'thad do/ 'o na mdo sde nas gsungs pa'i lha la yo ga'i sgrub thabs kyang rung mod ce na/ spyir rgyud sde gong ma'i rnal 'byor pa mtshan nyid tshang bas mdo sngags kyi lha thams cad rang nyams su gang len gyi rnal 'byor gyis sgrub tu rung mod/

de dbang ma thob pa'i gang zag 'og ma dang thun mong du spyad du mi rung ste/ nar son pa'i gyad pas rdo chen po skyod du rung yang de byis pa chung ngu dang thun mong gi las su sbyar mi rung ba bzhin no/ /des na mdo lugs kyi cho ga gcig 'dod phyin chad/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis mdzad pa'i dri med cho ga dang 'di gnyis las lhag pa'i rgya gzhung dang de'i khungs kyang mchod pa'i sbyor ba ni btsun pa kun dga' bo zhes sogs dang*/ sprin chen po'i char dbab pa'i le'u sogs las lhag pa mi rnyed pas 'di dag ji bzhin du bya la/ 'di dag la rang lugs kyi mchod pa by-in brlabs khyad 'phags yod bzhin du thog mar yo ga dang bla med kyi mchod pa byin brlabs dang gtor ma 'bul tshul sogs ni legs cha bsdus par rloms pas nyes chen byung ba'o/ /der ma zad mchims kyis phyogs skyong dang gnod sbyin la mdo lugs kyi gtor ma mdzad pa'ang gzhung du mi 'byung bas ma byas kyang rung la byed na'ang mdo lugs gtsang ma dgos so/ /des bum pa sgrub tshul la sa bon gyi bskyed chog bshad pa'ang mi 'thad pas bum pa sngar bzhin bshams pa gzungs sngags bzlas pa'i 'od kyis sbyin gyis brlabs pa'i chur bsams pa tsam mo/ /de bzhin du bde gshegs byang sems sogs kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan deng sang gi mchod phreng la grags pa rnams bshad pa'ang*/ mdo'i khungs med cing*/ rnal 'byor rgyud nas byams 'jam dbyangs sogs kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan bshad pa skabs su ma bab pa dang khyad par gnod sbyin gyi phyag mtshan ni rgyud kyi khungs kyang ma mthong bas dka' zhing chos dkon mchog gtso bor lung la sbyar nas gsungs pa la spyir lha sku dang dgos chos spyi la sbyor rgyu sher phyin kho na dang de yang yo ga nas bshad pa'i dmar ser phyag g.yas sogs ni rang bzo kho na yin no/ /'on kyang cho ga 'di la rnal 'byor mdzad pa'i gang zag mang po byang chub sems dpa' dag pa'i snang ba khyad par can mnga' ba byon pa rnams kyi gzigs snang sogs yin srid pas mtha' gcig tu dgag par mi nus shing ri mor bri ba sogs la sku mdog phyag mtshan nges pa can byed na snga ma'i phyag len la brten pa las ma 'das pas phyag mchod kyi skabs su 'gal ba cher med par mngon no/

/ gsum pa ni/ de ltar na bshams tshul gong du bshad pa bzhin legs par byas la/ bsgom tshul/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyang mdo lugs gtso bor bya zhing*/ swa bha wa sogs mi brjod par chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa yin pa la de ltar ma rtaugs pa'i zhes sogs de ltar grags pa ltar tshad med bzhi bsgoms nas cho ga dngos la 'jug par bgyi'o/ /zhes pa'i mthar/ bla ma sangs rgyas chos tshogs yid dam la/ /zhes sogs 'og nas 'chad pa'i tshigs gcad gcig brjod/ de nas dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang zhes sogs byin brlabs skor bzhi'i dang po'i mthar tshigs gcad gnyis dang gzhan gsum la re re de nas spyan 'dren gyi mthar tshigs gcad gcig de nas bla ma sangs rgyas chos byang sems gnod sbyin gyi bar gyi phyag 'tshal/ de nas 'phags pa'i tshogs zhes sogs kyi mthar mchod pa kun 'bul sogs tshigs bcad gcig de nas gdan mdzom gyi mthar gcig de nas bde gshegs brgyad sogs phyag 'tshal re re'i mthar yang sngar gyi rang rang gi phyag 'tshal gyi tshigs gcad dang smon lam so so'i mthar smon lam gsol gdab kyi tshigs gcad rnams brjod cing btang rag gi phyag la'ang spyi phyag dang 'dra ba ji ltar rigs pa'i mtha' dang*| bzod gsol gyi mthar yang tshigs gcad sbyar ba ni chog khrigs gsar pa yin la gzhan ni spyan 'dren gyi tshigs gcad re tsam mnan pa ma gtogs cho ga'i gzhung ji lta ba bzhin la gnon pa cung zad kyang ma byas pa shin tu dag cing tshar mang po dgos par de nyid shin tu legs so/ /tshar mang po mi dgos shing rgyas pa la dga' ba dang long yod na mtshan gyi me tog ma la sogs pa gtso bor bya zhing kun mkhyen kun la gzigs ma la sogs pa dang*/ rnam dag stong gsum ma la sogs pa dang*/ gser gyi mdog can skyabs sbyin phyag rgya can/ /la sogs pa'ang rung gi spyir gsang sngags dang dgos bla med kyi thun mong min pa'i tshigs gcad/

gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid la sogs pa dang*/ chos kyi skabs su yum chen mo dang sgrol ma rnam rgyal sogs blo la yod tshad 'don pa sogs ni skabs su mi 'bab bo/ /gtang rag gi gong du skabs 'dir khrus bya zhes gsungs pas/ tad+yathā/ ghu me sogs dang*/ tad+yathā/ bhai ṣa dz+ye gnyis/ mahā bhai ṣa dze/ rā dzā sa muṅga te swāhā/ zhes ci mang bzlas pa'i bum chus lha la'ang khrus gsol zhing nad pa'ang yod na khrus bya'o/ /gshin po la rigs drug rnam dag tu grags pa'i snying ma'i gshin chog dang bsres pa ni nam kyang mi 'thad la spyan 'dren gyi mjug tu gshin po yang dkyil 'khor gyi drung du bkug par mos te/ des gtso bo byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyang phyag mchod smon lam 'debs kyin yod par mos nas/ de dag gi ram 'degs cho ga ba rnams kyis byed par mos te/ bdag cag la sogs pa'i zhes sogs sor bzhag na nus pa che mod kyi| tshe 'das zhes sogs 'don pa spo na'ang 'gal ba cher med do/ /mdor na deng sang yongs su grags pa'i cho ga phyogasasgrigs phal cher mchims pa nas brgyud pa'i khyad par can du snang bas/ chos rin kyang mi chog cing cung dar bas 'chos kyang dka' bas na spros pa la dga' na rang sar bzhag par bya'o/ /'on kyang byang 'dren pa mi res blun po'i mkhas khyad gang dran mang po gsar du bcug na| bstan pa rin po che btsog chus slad par 'gyur bas chos la dbang za bar mi bya'o/ /'dir chog khrigs gsar pa'i tshigs gcad ni bla ma sangs rgyas chos tshogs yi dam la/ /byang chub bar du gus pas bdag skyabs 'chi/ /'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir/ /phun tshogs mdo sde'i cho ga bsgrub par bgyi// spyi dgos dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ /chos dbyings rnam dag tshogs gnyis lhag bsam mthus/ /ma dag 'khrul pa'i las snang rags pa kun/ /nub nas dag pa'i snang bar gyur pa ni/

/rnam dag zhing gi phun tshogs kun bsdus pa'i/ /yid 'phrog sa gzhir rin chen bye bas brgyan/ yon tan mang ldan dag gsal chu mtsho dang*/ /dpag bsam ljon pas phyogs kun brgyan par shog /de dbus gzhal med khang chen bde gshegs gnas/ /rin chen bdun bkod phyi nang kun du gsal/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i dge legs kyis// legs par brgyan pa'i khang bzang grub gyur cigade na'ang rin chen las grub seng ge'i khri/ /pad+ma'i snying por bde gshegs dam pa'i chos/ /'phags tshogs so so'i mnga' thang ji bzhin du/ /gdan khri mdzes pa sha stag 'byung gyur cig |phyi nang kun du rang rang cha rim bzhin/ /mchod sprin bsam yas phung po gsum pa yi/ /mdo dang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam bzhin/ grub nas dgyes shing legs par spyod gyur cig /ston pa sangs rgyas zhing bskul ting 'dzin gyis| |bde gshegs bdun po mngon sum spyan drangs ltar/ dad mos thugs rjes bde gshegs 'khor bcas rnams/ /'dir gshegs rang rang gdan la zhugs su gsol/ /gang gi zhabs pad brten pa'i bka' drin las/ /ngan 'gro srid zhi'i skyon yon rig gyur nas/ /skyes bu don la sems pa'i skabs rnyed pa// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang rnams rim par brgyud pa'i bka' drin las/ /sngon tshe rgyal bas gsungs pa'i phan bde'i lam/ /shin tu rnyed dka' bdag gis rnyed gyur pa/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po zas gtsang sras/ /blo chen gsung gi dbang phyug 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /de sras gangs can dpal mgon zhi ba 'tsho/ bka' drin mtshungs med gsum la= /bod 'bangs thugs kyi dkyil bzung khri srong lde// de sras mu ne gtsan dang sad na legs/ /chos sems gtsang ma'i zhabs dang 'od kyi bsrung/ /snga dar chos rgyal rnams la = /mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsanadang nyi ma mgon/ /bkra shis lde dang lha btsun khu dbon gnyis/

zhi ba 'od dang 'od lde rtse lde'i zhabs/ /phyi dar chos rgyal rnams = /mnga' ris gnar dang zhu lhan chu lhad pa/ /gro mo che dang sgom seng nam mkha' grags/ bsod ye bsod grags bsod rgyal bzang po dpal/ /lo chen yab sras rnams la = gangs can phan bde'i dpal 'byor 'byung ba'i sgo/ /dman mchog kun gyi sgrub tu rung ba'i lam| |chos rgyal thugs dam mdo sde'i cho ga 'di/ /'dzin skyong spel mdzad rnams la= /don gnyis mthar phyin ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ bden gnyis zung 'jug bstan pa dam pa'i chos/ /tshogs gnyis nyams len 'phags mchog dge 'dun ste/ /skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la= /shar phyogs gaṅgā'i klung gi bye rnyed na/ /gzhan gyis mi thub rnam dag zhing gi dpal/ bgrang yas sems dpas bskor ba'i bcom ldan 'das/ /mtshan legs yongs grags dpal la = /'di bzhin sbyar zhing rkang pa gsum sor bzhag ste/ klung bdun/ lnga'i/ bdun/ brgyad/ dgu'i/ bcu'i bye rnyed na/ rin chen ldan pa'i/ spos kyi yongs bkang*/ mya ngan bral ba'i/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rin chen rgya mtsho'i/ baiḍūr+ya snang rnam dag zhing gi dpal/ /rin chen zla ba'i zhabs= /gser bzang dri med snang = /mya ngan med mchog dpal = /chos grags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs = mngon mkhyen rgyal po'i zhabs = /thugs rje brtson 'grus mchog gi rtser gshegs pas/ /snyigs dus rgyal ba gzhan gyis mi 'dul ba'i/ /mi mjed tshe lo brgya pa'i zhing gi dpal/ /'dren mchog shākya'i tog = /kun 'byung mun pa'i sa bon mthar mdzad cing*/ /sdug bsngal zug rngu'i rtsa ba drungs nas 'byin/ rgyal yum shes rab pha rol phyin la sogs/ /theg gsum dam pa'i chos la= chos kyi rgyal bu gzhon nu mkhyen pa'i gter/ /bdag cag nyes brgyas bzir ba'i 'gro ba la/ /zab yangs lam 'di mngon du gyur mdzad pa/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs = /thabs mkhas thugs rje phul du byung ba'i mthus/

/dus min 'chi gso rgyal srid spel sogs slad/ /mchod pa'i sbyor ba gsal bar ston mdzad pa/ /'phags pa skyabs grol mdzad = /yangs pa can du bde gshegs brgyad 'dzoms nas/ /spyi dgos bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgos shing*/ /rang rang bden pa'i ngag gis zhal bzhes pa/ /gsang bdag 'khor dang bcas = yangs pa can du sman bla'i mtshan thos pas/ /bden mthong mdo 'di bsrung bar dam bcas pa/ /bdun 'bum 'khor gyis bskor ba'i bcu gnyis po/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' khyab zhing gi phyag 'os thams cad la/ /yon tan zhing du lhag par mos pa'i blos/ /'gro kun zhing rdul grangs rnyed lus sprul nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing mthar rtag tu gus phyag 'tshal/ /mchod pa kun 'bul sdig pa mtha' dag bshags/ /dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /dge rtsa rdzogs byang nyid du bsngo bar bgyi/ /bdag cag dus ngan sems can skyabs pa'i phyir| |bde gshegs rnams kyi smon lam gang btab dang*/ /thub dbang sras dang bka' bstod bcas pa yis/ /bka' stsal zhal bzhes mtha' dag 'grub gyur cig /mtshan legs rgyal por phyag mchod mtshan bzlas mthus/ /rgyal ba mchog des sngon tshe gzhan don du/ /nad gdon rims sogs 'jigs pa mtha' dag zhi/ /'on long smyo sogs sdug bsngal nad rgyun chad/ /dmyal ba'i las zad lha mi'i bde ba myong*/ /dbul 'phongs kun kyang dbyig sogs yo byad 'phel/ bcings dang rdeg sogs lus gdung mtha' dag zhi/ /mgon med dug sprul sogs kyis gtses las thar// 'thab rtsod 'gyed rnams phan tshun byams sems ldan| |chus khyer smre sngags 'don rnams dbugs phyin shog /ces pa'i smon lam chen po rnam pa brgyad/ /bdag sogs 'gro bas myur du 'grub par shog/ shi 'phos dag pa'i zhing der pad+ma la/ /rdzus skyes yon tan kun rdzogs de la sogs|

|rgyal ba kun mnyes skad cig skad cig la/ /sangs rgyas zhing kun bgrod pa'i mthu thob shog /rin chen zla ba/ gser bzang dri med/ mya ngan med mchog chos grags rgya mtsho/ mngon mkhyen rgyal po/ sman gyi rgyal por/ phyag mchod sogs thog mtha' snga ma bzhin sbyar la/ dbul g.yengs dge las nyams rnams dge chos 'phel/ /bkres skom las zad mtho ris phun tshogs rgyas/ /bu nad mi myong rtag tu skyes par 'gyur/ /bshes bral mya ngan gyis gdung mya ngan bral| |mun par gdon gyis gtses rnams gdon sogs thar/ /dman mos dge mchog bral rnams lung rtogs rgyas/ /theg chen spong rnams rdzogs byang bsam sbyor brtan/ /bar ma'i sdug bsngal myong rnams bsil thob shog /ces brgyad dang*/ bsad pas tshe thung gyur rnams yun ring 'tsho/ /rkus phrog dbul por skyes rnams longs spyod 'phel/ /gnod sems 'thab cing rtsod rnams byams pa rgyas/ tshul 'chal sdom gnas sems bskyed sgrib byang shog /ces bzhi dang*| mya ngan sogs myong skyon bral tshe ring bde/ /dmyal bar mya ngan med mthong bde ba 'bar/ /dbul po mdog ngan lus mdzes longs spyod 'phel/ /'byung pos mdangs 'phrog zhi zhing byams gnas shog /ces bzhi dang*/ dad med log lta dad ldan yang dag lta/ /mtha' 'khob dge nyams mtshan gyi byams sems bskyed| |dbul bas sdig byed 'byor ldan sdig dang bral/ /'thab cing rtsod rnams slar log byams gnas shog /ces bzhi dang*/ bya ba ngan zhen 'byor ldan dge ba 'phel/ /mi dge'i lam zhugs dge lam rgyu 'bras thob/ /gzhan dbang gyur rnams rang dbang bde ba 'phel/ /tshe 'thung rgyu bsags mtshan thos tshe ring shog |ces pa bzhi dang*/ mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar kun kyang bdag 'drar gyur| |baiḍūr 'od 'bar gling bar mun pa zhi/ /shes rab thabs kyis yo byad zad mi shes/ /dman mos lam ngan zhugs rnams lam mchog bsgrod/ /sdom gsum ma nyams tshul ldan ngan song bral/

/mdog ngan nad pa yan lag dbang po tshang*| |nad kyis gzir rnams nad med yo byad 'phel/ /bud med skyon gzir de bral skyes dbang ldan/ /lta ngan bdud zhags yang dag lta bas sbyangs/ rgyal pos mnar rnams gnod pa kun las thar/ /bkres pas sdig byed chos 'byor kha zas myongs/ /tsha sogs gos thob 'phags tshul rnam sgrol shogaces pa'i smon lam chen po bcu gnyis po/ /zhes sogs sbyar/ shākya'i rgyal por phyag 'tshal mchod pa'i mthus/ /rgyal ba mchog des snyigs dus 'gro ba'i slad/ bde gshegs bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam dang*/ /cho ga'i bsam sbyor khyad par can rnams gsungs/ /brgyad ka 'dzoms nas baiḍūr gzungs chen gyi/ /phan yon gsungs nas tshul 'dir bskul ba ltar/ /deng 'dir 'bad las legs tshogs gang thob pa/ /bdag sogs/ dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal sogs/ mtshan thos tsam gyis skyon zad yon tan 'phel/ /zhes sogs bde gshegs bka' lung 'gyur med rnams/ /bdag 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ khyod kyis yon tan bsam yas mdo sde 'di/ /thub la nan gyis zhus pa'i phan yon kun/ /bdag skyabs grol mdzad la/ /sman bla'i mtshan gyis nyam thag nad pa dang*/ /dus min 'chi gso rgyas srid rgyal sogs rnams/ /bdag gsang bdag mgon dang tshangs dbang rgyal chen sogs/ /dam can bsrung mar/ mdo 'di spyod par khyed rnams legs byon nas/ /bsrung skyobs skyon sel yon tan kun sgrub ces/ /dam bcas bro bor phan yon mang du bshad/ /gzungs stsal phyag rdor sgrub thabs bstan pa kun/ /bdag lhag par gegs bzlog mthun rkyen tshang gyur cigaganod sbyin rnams la/ khyod kyis sman bla'i mtshan thos bden pa mthong*/ /mdo 'di bsrung bar dam bcas ji bzhin mdzod/ /lhag par/ mtshams 'dir gzungs sngags bzla/ khrus bya'o/ /snyigs dus 'gro la dgongs pa'i bcom ldan 'das| |bde gshegs bdun dang thub dbang dam pa'i chos/ /'jam dbyangs skyabs grol phyag rdor 'khor dang bcas/

/gnod sbyin sde dpon rnams la gus phyag 'tshal/ /de ltar bde gshegs 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /phyag 'tshal mchod cing sdig bshags yid rang bskul/ /gsol gdab smon lam mthu yis chos rgyal srid/ /phan bde cher rgyas dam chos ring gnas shog /de skad gsol tshe sgo gsum nyes skyon gyi/ /nongs pa ci bgyis gnong zhing 'gyod pas bshags/ bzod pa bzhes nas rang rang gnas su zhud/ /spyan 'dren tshe na thugs rjes myur gshegs gsol/ /bkra shis kun gyi dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das/ /sogs/ gnod sbyin sde dpon rnams kyi bkra shis shog /ces pa la sman bla'i cho ga mtha' dag legs pa tshang zhing*/ sgrol ma tshar gsum gyi bar la 'grub pas blo nus che ba dag gis 'di kho nas 'grub la/ 'bring du na/ 'di'i tshigs gcad rnams rang rang gi skabs su sbyar ba'i mdo chog nyid la brten zhing*/ rgyas par ni bla ma snga ma'i phyag len dang tshigs gcad mdo dang mthun pa rnams sbyar la/ khyad par sman bla nyid la phyag dang bstod pa mang du bya/ thub pa'i skabs su gnas brtan phyag mchod kyang 'grub na legs so/ /de ltar mdo sde'i cho ga spyi dgos kyi/ rnam gzhag lag len legs par bshad pa 'di/ /mdo sngags tshul rig pradz+nya rat+nas sbyar| |dge bas tshul 'di phyogs mthar rgyas gyur cig /ces pa rnam 'gyur zhes pa lcags pho stag gi lo mgo'i zla ba'i tshes gcig la chos 'khor sgang du sbyar ba'o/ /rnam gzhag lag len legs par bshad pa 'di/ /gyad gnyer tshe 'das sgrib pa byang phyir du/ /bla brang nyid nas mthun rkyen dgos pa sbyar/ /'gro rnams ngan song gsum las grol gyur cig /spar mkhan mkhas pa chos kyi bzang*| |bris la mkhas pa tshul khrims 'phel// //maṅgalaṃ//
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/sman lha'i rnam gzhag cho ga nyams len bde 'jug -PAGE 218--PAGE 217-- PAGE 213-
